actions.new_string:
self.execution_arn = execution_arn
        self.name = execution_name
        self.start_date = datetime.now()
        self.state_machine_arn = state_machine_arn
        self.execution_input = execution_input
        
        # Set status based on SF_EXECUTION_HISTORY_TYPE
        sf_execution_history_type = settings.get_sf_execution_history_type()
        if sf_execution_history_type == "FAILURE":
            self.status = "FAILED"
            self.stop_date = datetime.now()
            self.error = "DefaultStateError"
            self.cause = "No Matches!"
        else:
            self.status = "RUNNING"
            self.stop_date = None
            self.error = None
            self.cause = None
            
        self.account_id = account_id
        self.region_name = region_name
        self.output = None
        self.output_details = None
